string.name: privacy_policy_intro
string.value: Honyomi is a local-first reader for manga, novels and videos. The app itself does not collect, upload or share any personal data.

string.name: privacy_policy_local_body
string.value: Your library, reading history, download records, preferences and tracker credentials are stored only on your device. You can export or erase them at any time in Settings. Uninstalling the app removes them permanently.

string.name: privacy_policy_network_body
string.value: Online content is provided by third-party extensions and websites. Browsing or reading from an online source sends your requests directly to that site, which is governed by its own privacy policy. The app does not control and is not responsible for third-party services.

string.name: privacy_policy_tracking_body
string.value: You can optionally connect tracker accounts such as AniList, MyAnimeList, Bangumi, Kitsu and Shikimori. Login is authorized by you on the tracker's own page, and access tokens are saved only on your device to sync reading progress.

string.name: privacy_policy_permissions_body
string.value: Internet access is used to load online content, file access for local imports and backups, and biometric authentication only for the local app lock. No permission is used to collect personal data.

string.name: privacy_policy_contact_body
string.value: Honyomi is an open-source project inspired by Mihon. If you have questions about this privacy statement, reach us via Discord or GitHub.
